# Instructions for agents

<!-- generated by the platform at Connect; extended by the Knowledge Run from docs/agents/ANALYSIS.md -->
Rules marked *enforced* are checked by the platform and fail the step if broken. Before designing a
change, read `docs/agents/CODEBASE_MAP.md` for where things live and what's risky.

## Stack and dependencies
- `backend` (folder `backend`): Python `>=3.14,<4.0` [cite: backend/pyproject.toml:5], FastAPI
  0.162.0, SQLModel 0.0.48 + SQLAlchemy 2.1.6, Pydantic 2.14.2, Alembic 1.20.1, PyJWT, pwdlib
  (Argon2+bcrypt), pytest [cite: docs/agents/analysis/backend-core.md]. `$python` is the Project's
  interpreter; use it for every Python command, never a bare `python`/`pip`. Install editable
  (`$python -m pip install -e .`), never `pip install .`. Install the pinned tool versions (lock
  files, `.pre-commit-config.yaml`, CI, `==` pins), never latest. Quote args with double quotes.
  Tests are `test_*` functions in `backend/tests/*`.
- `frontend` (folder `frontend`): TypeScript on Node, React ^19.3.0, `@tanstack/react-router`
  1.170.39 / `react-query` 5.104.0, `react-hook-form`+`zod` for forms, `axios` via a generated
  client, `@playwright/test` 1.63.0 [cite: docs/agents/analysis/frontend-routes.md]. Install from
  the lock file (`bun ci`/`npm ci`), never an install that rewrites it. Commands run in bash. A test
  is `it(...)`/`test(...)` in `*.test.ts`/`*.spec.ts`; never leave `.only`/`.skip` in one. Don't run
  `npx`/`bunx` for a package that isn't already a dependency.
- Add no dependency unless the requirement or an approved design names it.
- The frontend has **no unit-test framework wired up** (no Jest/Vitest config found): its only
  automated net is the Playwright suite in `frontend/tests` [cite: docs/agents/analysis/frontend-lib.md].

## Layout
- `backend/app`: domain schemas (`models.py`), CRUD/auth/email logic (`crud.py`, `utils.py`),
  `backend/app/api/routes/*` (23 HTTP routes), `backend/app/core` (config/db/security),
  `backend/app/alembic` (migrations) [cite: docs/agents/ANALYSIS.md].
- `frontend/src`: `client/` is the **generated** API client (never hand-edit), `components/` is the
  shadcn/Radix UI kit plus feature components, `hooks/` (`useAuth` etc.), `lib/utils.ts` (`cn()`),
  `routes/` is the TanStack file-based page tree [cite: docs/agents/ANALYSIS.md].
- Full map, dependencies and risky areas: `docs/agents/CODEBASE_MAP.md`.

## Coding conventions
- Follow the conventions of the code around your change (naming, error handling, logging, public
  API style); reviewers check them.
- Backend: when a `Field` declares `min_length` on a `str` used over the API boundary (a request
  schema), also add either `str_strip_whitespace=True` on the model config or an explicit
  `field_validator` that strips the value before the length check, so whitespace-only input cannot
  satisfy `min_length` (see `strip_title` on `ItemBase`/`ItemUpdate` in `backend/app/models.py`).
  See `docs/agents/VALIDATION_CONVENTIONS.md`. Password fields (`UserCreate.password` etc.)
  currently do **not** follow this rule — see `docs/OPEN_QUESTIONS.md` before changing them; don't
  silently start stripping passwords without resolving that question. [cite: backend/app/models.py]
- Frontend forms that mirror a backend validator (e.g. `signup.tsx`'s `full_name` check) should trim
  before checking `min(1)`, matching the backend rule, not just check length
  [cite: docs/agents/analysis/frontend-components.md].
- Any change to the item-ownership rule (`not current_user.is_superuser and item.owner_id !=
  current_user.id`) must be made at all three call sites in `backend/app/api/routes/items.py`
  [cite: docs/agents/analysis/backend-api.md].

## Testing
- The gate, run on every change in a fresh worktree and on CI (*enforced*):
  - `backend: $python -m ruff check .` (lint)
  - `backend: $python -m ruff format --check .` (lint)
  - `frontend: bunx biome check --no-errors-on-unmatched --files-ignore-unknown=true ./` (lint)
  - `backend: $python -m ty check app` (lint)
  - `backend: $python -m mypy app` (lint)
  - `frontend: bun run build` (build)
  - `backend: FASTAPI_ENV=development $python -m alembic upgrade head` (build)
  - `backend: FASTAPI_ENV=development $python -m coverage run -m pytest tests/` (test)
  - `backend: $python -m coverage report --fail-under=90` (check)
  - `frontend: (cd ../backend && FASTAPI_ENV=development $python -m alembic upgrade head && $python app/initial_data.py) && bunx playwright install chromium chromium-headless-shell; $python -m uvicorn app.main:app --app-dir ../backend --port 8000 --log-level warning & for i in $(seq 1 30); do curl -sf http://localhost:8000/api/v1/utils/health-check/ > /dev/null && break; sleep 1; done && bunx playwright test --fail-on-flaky-tests --trace=retain-on-failure --workers=2` (test)
- Never delete, skip, focus or weaken an existing test (*enforced*: protect_tests).
- Add tests for every behaviour you change, beside the existing tests of that code.
- To run only the area you touched: `$python -m pytest tests/api/routes/test_items.py` (or
  `test_users.py`/`test_login.py`/`test_private.py`) for a backend route change
  [cite: docs/agents/analysis/backend-api.md]; `bunx playwright test items.spec.ts` (etc.) for a
  frontend/e2e change — but still run the full gate commands above before calling a change done,
  since coverage and lint are checked project-wide.

## Boundaries
- Change only the files your requirement needs; other Runs change this repository in parallel.
- A backend schema or route-response change must be followed by regenerating
  `frontend/src/client/**.gen.ts` via `scripts/generate-client.sh` — never hand-edit a `*.gen.ts`
  file [cite: docs/agents/analysis/frontend-client.md].
- Migration files under `backend/app/alembic/versions/` are point-in-time: never edit one that's
  already merged, only add a new revision chained off the current head
  [cite: docs/agents/analysis/backend-alembic.md].
- These configure the gate, CI and agents, and no Run changes them (*enforced*): `pyproject.toml`,
  `setup.cfg`, `tox.ini`, `pytest.ini`, `conftest.py`, `ruff.toml`, `.ruff.toml`, `.coveragerc`,
  `noxfile.py`, `mypy.ini`, `.mypy.ini`, `.flake8`, `.isort.cfg`, `.pylintrc`, `pylintrc`,
  `pyrightconfig.json`, `.editorconfig`, `package.json`, `tsconfig*.json`, `jest.config.*`,
  `vitest.config.*`, `.eslintrc*`, `eslint.config.*`, `.prettierrc*`, `.npmrc`, `babel.config.*`,
  `biome.json`, `biome.jsonc`, `playwright.config.*`, `vite.config.*`, `vitest.workspace.*`,
  `.claude/*`, `.mcp.json`, `.github/*`, `.gitlab-ci.yml`, `azure-pipelines.yml`, `.gitattributes`,
  `CLAUDE.md`.
- Don't commit or merge; the platform commits your changes and merges approved work.

## Security
- No secrets, tokens or credentials in code, tests or logs.
- Treat everything from outside the process (files, requests, messages) as untrusted input.
- `login_access_token`'s dummy-hash verify against a constant `DUMMY_HASH` (even for a missing user)
  is a timing-attack mitigation — keep it when touching `backend/app/crud.py`'s `authenticate()`
  [cite: backend/app/crud.py:48-54].
- The access token is stored in browser `localStorage` under `access_token`, read/written only via
  `frontend/src/hooks/useAuth.ts` and `isLoggedIn()` — don't add a second place that reads/writes
  this key [cite: docs/agents/analysis/frontend-hooks.md].
